top_signals.title: Stocks Waver Ahead of PCE, Micron; Mideast Oil Flows Rebound; Trump Backs Outside AI Audits
top_signals.summary: US equity futures waver ahead of PCE inflation data and Micron earnings. Oil flows from the Middle East are returning toward pre-war levels despite continued risks to shipping, according to JPMorgan and Goldman Sachs. President Trump endorses independent audits of AI systems through an accord with tech executives. Mads Pedersen of Human Edge Investment Technology joins "Bloomberg Brief" to discuss bond market risks ahead of key economic data.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.summary: Wall Street traders drove stocks higher as short-dated Treasury yields fell, with slower-than-anticipated inflation data reinforcing bets the Federal Reserve will refrain from raising interest rates in October.
